## Selection examples

- **Splice-aware RNA genome alignment, STARsolo, junctions, RNA variants or coverage tracks**: [`bio-read-alignment-star-alignment`](bio-read-alignment-star-alignment/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/read-align-qc/references/bio-read-alignment-star-alignment/SKILL.md`. STAR covers these genome-alignment tasks; the source recommends alignment-free quantification for DE on known transcripts only.
- **DNA short-read alignment with Bowtie2, including ChIP/ATAC/CUT&RUN, soft-clipping or sensitivity tuning**: [`bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment`](bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/read-align-qc/references/bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment/SKILL.md`. Choose end-to-end or local mode and the sensitivity preset for the reads; inspect the source alternatives for variant, RNA and bisulfite alignment.
- **Cross-species/sample contamination, host/vector/PhiX/rRNA reads, index hopping or sample swaps**: [`bio-read-qc-contamination-screening`](bio-read-qc-contamination-screening/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/read-align-qc/references/bio-read-qc-contamination-screening/SKILL.md`. Includes deciding whether to report contamination, filter reads or align to a combined reference.

## Methods

### bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment

Method: [`bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment`](bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/read-align-qc/references/bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment/SKILL.md`.
Role: method. Source-declared name: `bio-read-alignment-bowtie2-alignment`.

Complete source description: Aligns DNA short reads to a reference with Bowtie2, choosing end-to-end (whole read must align) vs local (soft-clip read ends) mode and a sensitivity preset; the de-facto aligner for ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, and CUT&RUN, where fragment-geometry flags (--no-mixed, --no-discordant, --dovetail, -X) and a tool-appropriate MAPQ filter feed the peak caller. Use when aligning ChIP/ATAC/CUT&RUN reads, when read ends are adapter-contaminated and need soft-clipping, or when a tunable sensitivity/speed preset is wanted. DNA variant calling prefers bwa-alignment; RNA spliced alignment is star-alignment/hisat2-alignment; the QC gate and cross-tool MAPQ scale are alignment-files; peak calling is chip-seq/atac-seq; bisulfite uses methylation-analysis/bismark-alignment.

### bio-read-alignment-star-alignment

Method: [`bio-read-alignment-star-alignment`](bio-read-alignment-star-alignment/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/read-align-qc/references/bio-read-alignment-star-alignment/SKILL.md`.
Role: method. Source-declared name: `bio-read-alignment-star-alignment`.

Complete source description: Aligns RNA-seq reads to a genome with STAR, the fast splice-aware aligner whose splice-junction database (built from a GTF at sjdbOverhang = readlength-1) and two-pass mode set junction sensitivity, whose 255-for-unique MAPQ breaks GATK, and whose GeneCounts output reveals library strandedness. Use when RNA reads must be placed on the genome for novel-isoform discovery, fusion detection, RNA variant calling, coverage tracks, splicing QC, or single-cell (STARsolo). Memory-constrained RNA alignment is hisat2-alignment; DE on known transcripts only should skip alignment for rna-quantification/alignment-free-quant; the QC gate and contig-naming reconciliation are alignment-files; counting is rna-quantification; DNA is bwa-alignment/bowtie2-alignment.

### bio-read-qc-contamination-screening

Method: [`bio-read-qc-contamination-screening`](bio-read-qc-contamination-screening/SKILL.md); Read path: `skills/read-align-qc/references/bio-read-qc-contamination-screening/SKILL.md`.
Role: method. Source-declared name: `bio-read-qc-contamination-screening`.

Complete source description: Detects contamination in sequencing reads - cross-species (FastQ Screen, Kraken2), vector/PhiX/adapter, rRNA, and same-species cross-sample/index-hopping and sample swaps (SNP fingerprints via verifyBamID2/NGSCheckMate/somalier). Use when suspecting cross-contamination, PDX host reads, microbial carry-over, or sample swaps, and to decide whether to report, filter, or align to a combined reference. For deep taxonomic profiling use metagenomics/kraken-classification.
